title: Silo Cluster

excluded_sources.reason: grey render of the old LEGO model

gate_a.note: The variant has no usable street view: variant_2.png is a grey render of the old LEGO model. The oblique and roof views agree and are the authority. A person must rule on this before activation, as for the concert hall and the ski-slope plant.

measurement_contract.scale_basis: No image carries a scale. The back row's eight caps span 1010 px in the roof view; with the front row (1095 px) parted round the shaft, that is set to 76.4 m, matching the catalogue's suggested 80 m length, so the silos are 9.2 m across at a 9.6 m pitch (0.0756 m/px). Heights are proportioned in the oblique: the walls about 2.8 silo diameters (26 m) with 3 m caps, the gallery just over the cap tips, the shaft to 36 m and the head house to a 47 m eave. A pinhole fit to nine points gave 29 m walls and a 47 m eave at 32 px RMS, too loose to govern.

oblique: High view from the south-west toward rail yards and sheds.
Two rows of eight poured-concrete silos with pour lines, ribbed conical caps with ring railings and discharge spouts at their feet.

A concrete elevator shaft with a column of small windows stands proud of the front row between its two halves; a corrugated head house with a gable roof, a louvre and two ridge ventilators sits on it.
A corrugated conveyor gallery runs the length of the cluster over the caps on steel frames.
Walkways along the front row at about mid-height; two loading sheds, each as wide as two silos, with two truck bays each either side of the foot of the shaft, and concrete pads in front.
top: View from above and a little south of overhead, north up.
Back row of eight caps 1010 px long; front row 1095 px, parted round the shaft.
Gallery 1110 px long and 60 px wide along the middle of the cluster; head house 124 px wide, its ridge running north-south, with two ventilators.
Sheds and pads at the foot of the shaft; tall parts lean north by about 2 px per metre of height.

source_conflicts: variant_2.png, the street view, is a grey render of the old LEGO model, not a picture of this building. It is excluded; the oblique and roof views govern. Needs a ruling by a person.
The roof view is not overhead: tall parts lean north. Plan positions come from features at one height (the caps) and from the feet of the shaft and sheds.
The catalogue suggests an 80 by 50 m footprint; the images show a long cluster about 86 by 25 m with its yard; the images govern.
hidden_assumptions: The back row's north side, the ends and the shaft's back are not seen; the back row carries discharge spouts like the front (inferred).
The walkways are reached from the shaft through doors at their level; their stairs are not modelled.
The bays are shallow lit-less interiors 5.4 m deep; the plant inside the head house is not modelled.
Rail tracks, wagons, roads, trucks and neighbouring sheds belong to the site and are not modelled.

roof_contract.form: ribbed conical silo caps with ring railings, a gabled gallery and head house, shed roofs over the bays
roof_contract.weathering: every roof closes its volume; the gallery and head house stand on steel frames and the shaft
